[element-toc]
=== `<toc>` Table of Contents

Structural, multi-level Table of Contents, typically used for capturing a Table of Contents already present in a standards document being converted to this Tag Set, although it may also be used for Tables of Contents generated from standard and adoption metadata.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-adoption-front,`<adoption-front>`>>, <<element-back,`<back>`>>, <<element-front,`<front>`>>, <<element-toc-group,`<toc-group>`>>
#### Description

The following, in order: <<element-toc-title-group,`<toc-title-group>`>> <<element-toc-title-group,Table of Contents Title Group>>, zero or one <<element-p,`<p>`>> <<element-p,Paragraph>>, zero or more One or more of any of: <<element-toc-entry,`<toc-entry>`>> <<element-toc-entry,Table of Contents Entry>> <<element-toc-div,`<toc-div>`>> <<element-toc-div,Table of Contents Division>> <<element-fn-group,`<fn-group>`>> <<element-fn-group,Footnote Group>>, zero or more
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  toc          %toc-model;                                  >
....
#### Expanded Content Model

(toc-title-group?, (p)*, (toc-entry | toc-div)+, (fn-group)*)

#### Tagged Samples

#### Including navigation pointers as links

[source,xml]
....
...
<front>
 ...
 <toc>
  <toc-title-group>
   <title>Table of Contents</title>
  </toc-title-group>
  <toc-entry>
   <title>Foreword</title>
   <nav-pointer rid="fwd"/>
  </toc-entry>
  <toc-entry>
   <label>1</label>
   <title>Purpose</title>
   <nav-pointer rid="s1"/>
  </toc-entry>
  <toc-entry>
   <label>2</label>
   <title>Scope</title>
   <nav-pointer rid="s2"/>
   <toc-entry>
    <label>2.1</label>
    <title>The Journal Archive and Interchange Tag Set</title>
    <nav-pointer rid="s2.1"/>
   </toc-entry>
   <toc-entry>
    <label>2.2</label>
    <title>The Journal Publishing Tag Set</title>
    <nav-pointer rid="s2.2"/>
   </toc-entry>
   <toc-entry>
    <label>2.3</label>
    <title>The Article Authoring Tag Set</title>
    <nav-pointer rid="s2.3"/>
   </toc-entry>
  </toc-entry>
  <toc-entry>
   <label>3</label>
   <title>Format of this Standard</title>
   <nav-pointer rid="s3"/>
   <toc-entry>
    <label>3.1</label>
    <title>Description of the Tag Suite</title>
    <nav-pointer rid="s3.1"/>
   </toc-entry>
   <toc-entry>
    <label>3.2</label>
    <title>Description of each Tag Set</title>
    <nav-pointer rid="s3.2"/>
   </toc-entry>
  </toc-entry>
  ...
 </toc>
 ...
</front>
